name: now
title: Now
description: Show and switch your now CLI focus from the menu bar and a list with actions.
author: shanberg

commands.name: menu-bar-focus
commands.title: Show in Menu Bar
commands.subtitle: Now
commands.description: Show current now focus in the menu bar.

commands.name: list-focus
commands.title: Focus List
commands.subtitle: Now
commands.description: View focusable items and set focus or complete from a list.

preferences.name: focusFilePath
preferences.title: Focus file path
preferences.description: Path to your .now.md focus file. Use ~ for home (e.g. ~/.now/focus.now.md).

preferences.name: updateOneThing
preferences.title: Update One Thing
preferences.label: Open One Thing with current focus
preferences.description: When enabled, open the One Thing menu bar app with the current focus (one-thing:?text=…). Requires the One Thing extension installed.

preferences.name: appSpecificNowFiles
preferences.title: App-specific Now files
preferences.description: Optional JSON mapping from app bundle ID or name to Now file path. When set, the menubar (and list when opened) uses the path for the frontmost app. Example: {"com.apple.Terminal": "~/.now/term.now.md"}.

preferences.name: menubarTruncateLength
preferences.title: Menubar truncate length
preferences.description: Truncate the focus text in the menu bar to this many characters (0 = no truncation).

preferences.name: breadcrumbMaxLength
preferences.title: Breadcrumb max length
preferences.description: Max characters for breadcrumb; truncation is from the center. 0 = no limit.

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
